introSection.title: Your Application Is Only as Reliable as What It Runs On.
introSection.lead: A great product can still fail its users if the infrastructure behind it can't handle real traffic, goes down at the wrong moment, or wasn't built to scale in the first place.
paragraphs: At FuduGo, we design and manage cloud infrastructure around your actual usage patterns and growth plans, not a one-size-fits-all setup. Whether you need a new deployment pipeline, a migration to the cloud, or ongoing infrastructure management, we build systems designed to stay reliable as you grow.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.description: Clear answers about cloud deployment, migration, and how we use AI in infrastructure work.

items.question: What does FuduGo offer in cloud infrastructure?
items.answer: FuduGo provides cloud deployment and hosting, cloud migration, microservices architecture, and CI/CD pipeline setup across AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure.

items.question: Can you migrate our existing application to the cloud without downtime?
items.answer: In most cases, yes. We plan migrations in stages and test thoroughly at each step to minimize disruption to your live application.

items.question: Does FuduGo use AI in infrastructure work?
items.answer: Yes. We use AI-assisted tools to help standardize deployment configurations, review infrastructure code, and flag potential security gaps during setup.

items.question: Which cloud provider do you recommend?
items.answer: It depends on your application's requirements, existing tools, and budget. We assess your specific needs before recommending AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or another platform.

items.question: Do you provide ongoing infrastructure management, or just initial setup?
items.answer: Both. We can handle one-time deployment and migration work, or provide ongoing monitoring and management depending on what your team needs.
